policyPages.about-us:
## Helping you make a considered choice

VINtrue is designed to make vehicle history easier to understand. We bring available vehicle records together in one straightforward report so shoppers can ask better questions before buying.

## Information for your next step

Reports may include vehicle specifications, accident and title information, ownership records, recalls, past listings, and other details when available. Every vehicle has its own record history, and the information available can vary.

## Use reports thoughtfully

A report is a useful starting point, not a substitute for a professional inspection, a test drive, or checking official vehicle documents. If something matters to your decision, confirm it with the relevant authority or a qualified mechanic.
policyPages.terms:
## Using VINtrue

By using this website or purchasing a report, you agree to use the service lawfully and provide accurate information. You must be authorized to submit any vehicle details you enter.

## Reports and data availability

Vehicle reports compile information from third-party and public records. Records can be incomplete, delayed, or unavailable. VINtrue does not guarantee that a report contains every event in a vehicle’s history or that all information is error-free. Reports are for general informational purposes and are not a substitute for an independent vehicle inspection, an official title search, or professional advice.

## Orders and service

Package contents and prices are displayed before purchase. Please check your VIN or plate details and selected package before placing an order. A submitted order authorizes the selected payment method to be charged the displayed total.

## Acceptable use

You agree not to misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with service availability, or use vehicle information in ways prohibited by applicable law.

## Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to allvinreport@gmaila.com.
policyPages.privacy:
## Information you provide

To help prepare a vehicle report, we may process the VIN or license plate you submit, your contact information, and the information needed to complete your order. When you visit, your browser may ask to access your device location. A successful location reading is required to submit an order; we store the coordinates and reported accuracy with the order. Location access requires your browser permission and a secure (HTTPS or localhost) connection.

## Device and order records

When an order is submitted, we record the request IP address and derived browser, device, and platform categories. We also retain order creation and completion times, report delivery records, and report-link access logs to operate the service, prevent fraud, and respond to disputes.

## How information is used

We use submitted information to provide the requested report, process payment, respond to support requests, protect the service, and meet applicable legal requirements.

## Service providers

Information may be shared with service providers that help process payments, retrieve vehicle records, deliver reports, and operate the website.

## Retention and security

We keep order and support information for as long as reasonably needed to provide the service, resolve disputes, and meet legal obligations.

## Your choices

Device location is required to submit an order. Your browser must grant location permission; declining or blocking the prompt prevents order submission. We store the coordinates and reported accuracy with the order. For questions about personal information or to request access or correction where applicable, contact allvinreport@gmaila.com.

## Updates

We may update this policy as our services change. The date above shows when the latest version was published.
policyPages.cancellation:
## Cancellation requests

Contact customer support promptly if you want to cancel an order. We review requests based on the order and report preparation status, subject to applicable law.

## Digital delivery

A vehicle inspection report is a digital product. Once the report is delivered, it cannot be returned, as disclosed during checkout.

## Contact

Email allvinreport@gmail.com with your order reference and the email address used at checkout.
policyPages.refund:
## When a report order may qualify

If a paid report cannot be delivered because of a technical issue on our side, or submitted vehicle details cannot be processed, contact customer support. We will review the order and, where appropriate, arrange a replacement report or refund.

## How to request help

Email allvinreport@gmaila.com with your order reference, the email used at checkout, and a short description of the issue. Please do not include full payment-card details.

## Order review

Because a vehicle report is a digital service prepared using submitted vehicle details, requests made after report delivery are reviewed individually. Duplicate charges and paid orders that were not fulfilled will be investigated.

## Refund timing

Once approved, refunds are sent to the original payment method. Your bank or payment provider controls how long the credit takes to appear.

## Before you order

Please carefully check your VIN or license plate and selected package before payment. Report availability varies by vehicle and data source.
